actionName.description: The action used to update the code editor contents.

actionParamName.description:
The name of the parameter for the action that is being called. Note, the shape of this parameter
must be a map where the key represents the file URI and the value is the content to be saved.

typeName.description: The type name of the API to use to save the code editor contents.

title: The specification for saving the contents of the {@link UiSdlCodeEditor} component.
